description: This file defines the App class which extends Symfony's HttpKernel and manages application lifecycle, including request handling, service container management, route management, error handling, and debug mode toggling within the Goteo application.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class extending Symfony's HttpKernel, responsible for managing requests, services, routes, errors, and debug mode within the Goteo framework.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current Request object, creating it from globals if not already set.

methods.name: getServiceContainer
methods.description: Returns the service container, including it from a PHP file if not already loaded.

methods.name: isService
methods.description: Checks if a service exists in the container.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves a service from the container.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an event through the event dispatcher service.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Returns the route collection, including it from a PHP file if not already loaded.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Creates or returns the singleton instance of the App, initializing request, routes, and service container as needed.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Enables or disables debug mode, affecting error display, logging, and profiling.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request, sends the response, and terminates the application.

methods.name: clearApp
methods.description: Resets the singleton instances and stored data within the App class.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns the array of collected errors.

methods.name: errorHandler
methods.description: Custom error handler to log and display errors, collecting error info and calling a logger service.
